meta.title: Todos
meta.description: Adds a Todos panel to the sidebar. Record todo items, mark them done, and give each an optional due time; the list highlights overdue and due-soon items with live time hints and All / Active / Done filters. Right-click any todo and choose "Execute in workspace" to start a new conversation in the chosen workspace with that todo (deadline included) as the prompt. Items are stored on this machine in a JSON file under the DSH home directory (.dsh/dsh-todo-panel/items.json) and survive app restarts and port changes.
